capabilities: Add priority, schedule, and recurrence to todos.
Link tasks to projects and sources.
Track time spent on tasks using timers.
Visualize task progress via a side panel and calendar.
disambiguation: Organized is not a query language, a kanban board, or a dashboard builder.
extras: Currently in the process of being registered as an official Obsidian community plugin and requires manual installation until approval.
intentEvidence: Organized is neither a calendar you plan in nor a database you query.
motivation: To give todos memory and context without requiring users to adopt a separate system or move their work out of plain Markdown files.
problem: Standard daily note tasks lack persistence, context (projects, deadlines), and history, forcing users to move them out of their primary workflow.
summary: A task management system that adds memory, scheduling, and project context to Markdown-based todos within daily notes.
